end_line: The Vegans Explore Podcast, Episode 147, Sunday, November 22.

captions.text: My husband and I, we're both Vegan.
I was born and raised in Vietnam.
When I became Vegan, I couldn't find Vegan Vietnamese food in New York City,
to my surprise, because New York City is one of the most Vegan-friendly cities.
So first, we just solved our own problem, right?
We opened a Vietnamese restaurant to serve Vietnamese food
and to share with everyone who wants to see what Vietnamese Vegan food tastes like.

end_cta: Find Sen Saigon and more Vegan spots in New York
